meta.title: {brand} — fact-checking for Madagascar's newsrooms
meta.description: Check a claim, find its sources and the right experts, in Malagasy, French and English.

verify.name: Check a claim
verify.desc: A text or a link. Claims are isolated, matched against sources found by web search, and scored by code.

image.name: Authenticate an image
image.desc: EXIF metadata, visual analysis presented as hints, reverse search links. Never "real" or "fake".

monitor.name: National monitoring
monitor.desc: RSS feeds from Malagasy media, filtered by source, language and topic. Title, link and excerpt only.

translate.name: Translate
translate.desc: Malagasy, French, English. Generated Malagasy is always marked "to be reviewed".

experts.name: Find an expert
experts.desc: A topic, a region, a language. Experts come only from the consented directory, never from the model.

stats.name: Figures and agenda
stats.desc: A few key indicators, each with its source, reference period and update date.

angles.name: Story angles
angles.desc: Three to five angles built only on confirmed claims, with questions and profiles to interview.

landing.positioning: Sources, experts, context. In three languages.

manifesto.before: {brand} never says true or false. It shows the sources, weighs how solid they are and flags what is missing. In the end,

toolsHead.title: Seven tools, one newsroom
toolsHead.sub: Every claim journalists made has its own screen. The first five are live.

words.hint: No claim without a link you can open.
Three articles copying one press release count as one.
The tool ranks the evidence; the conclusion stays human.

process.claim: "The price of rice doubled in a month."

steps.name: Paste
steps.desc: A message, an article or a link. The text is never written to our logs.

steps.name: Search
steps.desc: The model searches the web. Any source it cites without having found it is removed.

steps.name: Weigh
steps.desc: Code computes the index from source type, independence and date.

rule.kicker: OF DISPLAYED LINKS COME FROM THE WEB SEARCH
rule.text: A source the request's own search did not return is never shown. The claim then falls back to "insufficient".
rule.author: {brand} RULE NO. 1

workspace.overviewTitle: What do you want to check?
workspace.overviewLead: Pick a tool. Screens "in preparation" show what is coming, without invented data.

common.demoNote: Demonstration data: the model was not called.

verify.title: Check a claim
verify.lead: Paste a text or a link. {brand} isolates the checkable claims and looks for their sources.
verify.placeholderText: Paste the message, article or statement to check…
verify.example: Madagascar's poverty rate reached 75% in 2022 according to INSTAT, and the price of rice doubled in a month in Antananarivo.
verify.indexNote: Not a probability: the index measures the quality of the evidence.
verify.noSource: No source found by the web search.
verify.dropped: {count, plural, =0 {No source removed} one {# source cited without being found was removed} other {# sources cited without being found were removed}}
verify.empty: No checkable claim was found in this text.

experts.title: Find an expert
experts.lead: Describe the topic. Profiles come only from the directory, with consent.
experts.topicPlaceholder: E.g. rising rice prices in Antananarivo
experts.broadened: Few experts in this region: the search was widened to the whole country.

image.title: Authenticate an image
image.lead: Drop a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo, or an MP4 or WebM video. Photos are reduced and videos turned into 6 key frames on your device: only those images are sent, and GPS coordinates never leave the phone.
image.drop: Drop an image or a video here
image.noExif: No metadata: WhatsApp and Facebook strip it on upload.
image.reverseNote: The image is not sent to these services: open them and drop it yourself.
image.preparing: Preparing the image on your device…

metadataSource.device: read on the device before compression

video.extracting: Extracting key frame {done} of {total} on your device…
video.note: Only 6 still frames were checked: the sound, the editing and the rest of the video were not analysed.

aiDetection.title: AI generation index
aiDetection.note: Indicative, not a probability. A low index does not prove the image is authentic.
aiDetection.source: {provider} detector, checked on {date}. The image, reduced and without metadata, is sent to {provider} for this check.

unavailable.not_configured: The detector is not configured on this server: no index was computed.
unavailable.failed: The detector did not respond: no index was computed. Try again later.
unavailable.mock: Demonstration mode: the detector was not called.

translate.title: Translate
translate.lead: Translate a short text between Malagasy, French and English.
translate.review: TO BE REVIEWED BY A SPEAKER
translate.example: The ministry announced a new vaccination campaign in schools.

angles.title: Story angles
angles.lead: Start from a topic, or from the confirmed claims of your last check.
angles.subject: Topic
angles.subjectPlaceholder: E.g. the surge in rice prices in the capital
angles.fromVerification: {count, plural, one {# claim taken from the check} other {# claims taken from the check}}
angles.example: The surge in rice prices in Antananarivo

monitor.title: National monitoring
monitor.lead: Public RSS feeds from Malagasy media, grouped into events. Title, link and short excerpt only: read the article on the outlet's site.
monitor.empty: No article matches these filters over the period. Widen the period or remove a filter.
monitor.coverageLine: {matched} articles kept out of {fetched} read, from {sources} of {configured} outlets.
monitor.truncated: Too many articles: only the most recent are shown.
monitor.eventFacts: {articles, plural, one {# article} other {# articles}}, {sources, plural, one {# outlet} other {# outlets}}

coverage.divergent: Outlets do not tell the same story

limits.headlines_and_excerpts_only: Only the title and a short excerpt are read: the full article stays on the outlet's site.
limits.lexical_event_grouping: Articles are grouped by shared words: two close stories can be merged or split by mistake.
limits.location_inferred_from_text: Region and district are inferred from the text: they can be missing or wrong.
limits.ai_summary_from_headlines: Summaries and divergences are written by AI from titles and excerpts only: check them in the articles.
limits.ai_analysis_unavailable: AI version comparison is unavailable: events are shown without it.
limits.ai_analysis_skipped: Version comparison was not run for this search.
limits.ai_references_filtered: AI references to articles missing from the feeds were removed.
limits.feed_failures: Some feeds did not answer: monitoring is incomplete.
limits.articles_truncated: The number of articles was capped: the oldest are not shown.
limits.mock_demo_data: Demonstration data: these are not real articles.

monitor.policy: Public RSS feeds only. No article is copied: title, link, short excerpt, source and date.

stats.title: Key figures
stats.lead: The latest figures published for Madagascar by the World Bank. Each value shows its year, its source and its update date.
stats.agendaEmpty: No upcoming date has been announced by an official source. A date is added only when the source itself publishes it.

files.title: My files
files.lead: The checks you chose to save. They stay in this browser and are never sent to a server.
files.empty: No saved files yet. Run a check, then click "Save to My files".

credits.title: Photo credits
credits.lead: All photos come from Wikimedia Commons under free licenses. They were resized and their metadata removed. None was generated by AI.
credits.author: Author

offline.title: You are offline
offline.lead: Checking a claim requires the network: sources are searched live and nothing is invented without them.
offline.files: Your saved dossiers stay on this device. They will show again as soon as the connection is back.

evidence.software: Editing software found in the metadata: {value}.
evidence.dateTaken: Date taken declared in the metadata: {value}. An EXIF date does not prove when the photo was really taken.
evidence.creationDate: Creation date declared in the metadata: {value}. An EXIF date does not prove when the file was really created.
evidence.gps: GPS coordinates are present in the metadata. They do not prove the photo was taken at that place.
evidence.locationClue: Visual analysis (AI) — clue about the place: {value}
evidence.noInconsistency: The visual analysis found no major inconsistency. The absence of a clue does not prove the image is authentic.

limits.visionUnavailable: Automatic visual analysis is unavailable. The clues that depend on it could not be produced.
limits.visionOwn: The visual analysis reports its own limits: {value}
limits.uncertainAiHints: The signs of AI generation found are uncertain. Such a sign alone does not prove the image is fake.
limits.noSignal: The visual analysis found no significant clue.
limits.sameModel: Several observations may come from the same AI model; they are not several independent sources.
limits.noExif: No usable metadata was found. Some platforms, including WhatsApp and Facebook, strip metadata when images are shared.
limits.exifAndVision: The EXIF data and the visual analysis come from the same image; on their own, they are not several independent sources of corroboration.
limits.reverseLinks: The reverse search links are tools the journalist can open. They are not search results.
limits.detectorUnavailable: Automatic AI-generated image detection is unavailable: no generation index could be computed.
limits.detectorNotProbability: The AI generation index comes from an automatic detector. It is not a probability: detectors make mistakes, especially on compressed, edited or cropped images and screenshots.
limits.detectorNotProof: A low index does not prove the image is authentic; a high index does not prove it was generated.

summary.exifUnreadable: The EXIF metadata could not be read.
summary.noExif: No usable EXIF metadata was found. Its absence does not prove the image is fake.

fact.gps: GPS coordinates present in the metadata

summary.noVision: No visual analysis could be produced.
summary.detector: AI generation detector ({provider}): index {index}/100, {level}. This index is indicative.
summary.conclusion: The check remains inconclusive: the available elements do not show that the image is authentic or manipulated.
